title: OpenAI removes its older text-to-speech models from the API on January 6, 2027
detail: A deprecation entry dated 2026-10-01 covers four text-to-speech models. The page states that they are deprecated and will be removed from the API on January 6, 2027, with at least three months notice. The models are tts-1, tts-1-hd, gpt-4o-mini-tts-2025-03-20 and gpt-4o-mini-tts-2025-12-15, and the listed replacement for all four is gpt-realtime-2.1-mini.
impact: Anyone running text-to-speech in production on tts-1, tts-1-hd or either gpt-4o-mini-tts snapshot loses those endpoints on January 6, 2027. The single replacement is in the realtime family rather than the speech family, so the request shape and the audio output both need re-testing, and three months is the shortest notice OpenAI commits to here.
